mapper.select: SELECT r.*, m.NAME as REPORTER_NAME FROM TB_REPORT r JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON r.REPORTER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT r.*, m.NAME as REPORTER_NAME FROM TB_REPORT r JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON r.REPORTER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE r.REPORT_ID = #{reportId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_REPORT SET STATUS = #{status}, HANDLED_BY = #{handledBy}, RESULT_NOTE = #{resultNote}, HANDLED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE REPORT_ID = #{reportId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SANCTION ( SANCTION_ID, MEMBER_ID, REPORT_ID, SANCTION_TYPE, REASON, START_DATE, END_DATE, ADMIN_ID, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_SANCTION.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{reportId, jdbcType=NUMBER}, #{sanctionType}, #{reason}, SYSDATE, #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{adminId}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO TB_REPORT ( REPORT_ID, REPORTER_ID, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, REASON, DETAIL, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_REPORT.NEXTVAL, #{reporterId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, #{detail}, 'PENDING', SYSDATE )
